name: magdev/php-assimp

adoption_signal.ranking_status: excluded; this metric does not enter the verified-parser ranking

probe.environment: PHP 8.5.12, Composer 2.11.2, Assimp CLI 6.0.6 on macOS
probe.setup: In a temporary directory, run composer require magdev/php-assimp:0.6.0 --update-no-dev --prefer-dist
probe.invocation: require vendor/autoload.php; construct Assimp\Command\Verbs\InfoVerb with the absolute control path; execute through Assimp\Command\Command('/opt/homebrew/bin/assimp')
probe.observed_result: Fatal error before Assimp CLI execution: Declaration of Assimp\Command\Result\AbstractResult::isExecuted() must be compatible with Assimp\Command\Result\Interfaces\ResultInterface::isExecuted(): bool
probe.separate_underlying_cli_check: assimp info controls/ascii_ply/triangle.ply succeeded and reported 3 vertices and 1 face; this does not verify the PHP wrapper

reason: The pinned PHP release cannot instantiate its InfoResult on the available runtime because its implementation lacks the interface return type. No observable format-aware result was obtained through the PHP package.
